name: compatibility-gate
description: Gate Renovate updates with source-backed compatibility.fyi metadata.

scripts.build: npm run build:action && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:action: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/index.js --platform=node --target=node24 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/cli.js --platform=node --target=node24 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
